info.title: SuperPipeline push registration
info.description: How a subscriber registers for SuperPipeline's direct push: an agent for its own work (`work.available`) and whatever else it subscribes to, and a service for record events and, as a decision carrier, the decision events. Written from SuperPipeline's apps/api/src/routes/boards/integrations.ts (the agent form), apps/api/src/service-routes.ts (the service form) and registerPushConfig in apps/api/src/board/push.ts. The delivery itself, the CloudEvent the board sends to `url` signed with `token`, is fixtures/cloudevents/push-delivery.json, and the bodies are the schemas schemas/catalog.json names. Every refusal is the error.v1 envelope with the status statusForCode gives its code. Response bodies are open: a reader ignores properties it does not know.

post.summary: Register or replace a push subscription on the board
post.description:
One route, two callers, told apart by the credential.

- **An agent** (agentToken, `claim`) subscribes itself: the subscriber is the agent the token authenticates, never one the body or a header names. `events` defaults to `["work.available"]` and `capabilities` to none. The capabilities `work.available` is matched on are the agent's own catalogue row when it has one, else the body's, expanded through the workspace's implication edges when the config is registered. A person (the web app's session, not a crossing) names the subscriber with `X-Agent-Id`, which may not name a service (`svc:`): INVALID_INPUT.
- **A service** (serviceToken) subscribes `svc:<principal>`, and must send `ServicePushConfigRequest`: `url`, a non-empty `token` and a non-empty `events`, else INVALID_BODY. It may subscribe to record events with `push:write` and to the decision events with `approval-requests:relay`; a scope it lacks is FORBIDDEN. `work.available` and `cards.stale` are an agent's own and are refused to a service with INVALID_BODY. A service's refusals from the board are all 400, so a board that is not initialised is 400 NOT_INITIALIZED there (404 on the agent form). A board outside the token's tenant is 404 BOARD_NOT_FOUND.

An event the board cannot push at all is UNKNOWN_EVENT; a `url` that is not a public http(s) endpoint is INVALID_URL. The config is upserted on (subscriber, url): registering the same url again replaces its token, capabilities and events and answers the same `configId`, still 201.

201.description: Registered, or the existing config for this subscriber and url replaced

agentToken.description: An agent's credential: a `spa_` token with the `claim` scope, or an Organization-plane token for an agent principal. A missing or unknown credential is 401 UNAUTHORIZED; a token without `claim` is 403 FORBIDDEN.

serviceToken.description: An Organization-plane token for a service principal (`principalKind: service`) of a workspace mapped to a SuperPipeline tenant: `push:write` for record events, `approval-requests:relay` for the decision events. The tenant comes from the token, so a board in another tenant is 404 BOARD_NOT_FOUND. No valid service token is 401 UNAUTHORIZED.

boardId.name: boardId
boardId.description: The board. The service form matches only brd_ and 16 lowercase hex digits.

agentIdHeader.name: X-Agent-Id
agentIdHeader.description: The subscriber a person names. Ignored for an agent token, which subscribes its own agent, and for a service token.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON (INVALID_JSON), a body of the wrong shape (INVALID_BODY, INVALID_INPUT), a url the board will not push to (INVALID_URL), an event it cannot push (UNKNOWN_EVENT), or, on the service form, a board that is not initialised (NOT_INITIALIZED)

Forbidden.description: The credential lacks the scope the subscription needs

NotFound.description: No such board in this tenant (BOARD_NOT_FOUND), or, on the agent form, a board that is not initialised (NOT_INITIALIZED)

PushConfigRequest.description: Either form. A service must send the tighter ServicePushConfigRequest; an agent may send either.

url.description: Where the board POSTs each delivery. A public http(s) endpoint, else INVALID_URL.

token.description: The secret each delivery to `url` is signed with.

capabilities.description: What `work.available` is matched on when the agent has no catalogue row of its own. Defaults to none.

events.description: The pushName of each event to receive (schemas/catalog.json): work.available, cards.stale, the decision events and the record events. Defaults to ["work.available"]. A name the board cannot push is UNKNOWN_EVENT.

url.description: Where the board POSTs each delivery. A public http(s) endpoint, else INVALID_URL.

token.description: The secret each delivery to `url` is signed with.

events.description: Record events (with `push:write`) and decision events (with `approval-requests:relay`), by pushName. `work.available` and `cards.stale` are an agent's own.

configId.description: The config's id: the same one again when an existing config was replaced.
